notes:
=== CONCEPT ===
FTP anonymous login allows access without credentials (username: anonymous, any password). When combined with write access (anon_upload_enable=YES), creates a path to RCE: upload a web shell to FTP root that overlaps with web root → access via HTTP.

=== CHAINING ===
nmap ftp-anon NSE confirms anonymous access → list directory (ls -la) → check for write permissions → if web root accessible: upload webshell → trigger via HTTP → RCE.

=== LOG POISONING ===
If FTP logs are readable via LFI, inject PHP code in the username field during login → include log file via LFI → code execution. Depends on FTP log path and LFI capability.

=== DETECTION ===
Anonymous FTP logins logged in vsftpd/proftpd logs. Bulk directory listing (wget -m mirror) generates abnormal traffic volume.
